name: Craig of the Hills
info: Craig of the Hills is made entirely in PowerPoint. We believe it is the longest PowerPoint game ever made. No VBA code either. Yes, lots of AI! Sorry we are not artists (yet)!

name: The Secret of Craig Hill
info: A horror game we worked on in Unreal Engine 5 featuring our video production teacher. We handled all the programming, audio, and level design for this project.

name: House of Horrors
info: A retro-styled horror game we worked on, but it ended up being used for a different project. This game is what the video titled "House of Horrors" was based on. We imported the footage into the Unreal Engine project and went from there.
